description: Create a Yolfi payment link only after the user approves product name, amount, currency, and one-time or recurring payment type.

collectAddress.description: Whether checkout should collect the customer address.

collectDateOfBirth.description: Whether checkout should collect the customer date of birth.

collectEmail.description: Whether checkout should collect customer email.

collectName.description: Whether checkout should collect the customer name.

collectPhoneNumber.description: Whether checkout should collect the customer phone number.

currency.description: Account currency code. Supported values are USD, EUR, and CNY.

imageUrl.description: Optional public product image URL shown on checkout.

metadata.description: Safe non-secret metadata such as source, productSlug, planId, or environment.

name.description: User-approved product, plan, donation, or access name shown on checkout.

price.description: User-approved decimal price, represented as a string to avoid numeric rounding.

recurringInterval.description: Recurring billing interval when type is RECURRING.

type.description: Payment link type: ONE_TIME or RECURRING.

name: yolfi_paylinks_create
title: Create Yolfi Paylink
